tone: Use concise, neutral Traditional Chinese suitable for a desktop utility.
capitalization: Do not imitate English capitalization; retain capitals only in protected Latin terms.
button_labels: Use familiar short action verbs and omit unnecessary subjects or punctuation.
ui_roles: Keep labels compact, buttons action-led, tooltips explanatory, and warnings or errors as natural complete messages.
technical_terms: Prefer established Traditional Chinese software terminology and preserve glossary tokens.
contextual_terminology: Choose ambiguous terms from the feature, stable ID, surface type, and neighboring strings instead of assigning one wording globally.
punctuation: Use full-width Chinese punctuation in sentences while preserving syntax tokens and accelerators.
units: Keep values and unit meaning unchanged, with conventional Traditional Chinese spacing.
natural_language: Reorder clauses naturally for Traditional Chinese and avoid Simplified-only terminology.
